ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with high-intensity (white/off-white) localized pixels; estimated 85:15 ratio of dark to light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of circular white rings (rosettes) across both lobes; concentrated white punctate clusters on the extreme lateral tips; solid low-intensity black region focused at the central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; base partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5-15 pixels creating a jagged profile against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing margins, tapering to sharp, upward-pointing acute angles at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast rings (barnacle attachment scars) ranging from 5-20 pixels in diameter, distributed across the mid and distal sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-intensity linear pixel disruptions; notably a prominent vertical parallel pair on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe and short diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of calcified barnacles visible on the leading edges of both lateral tips; global coverage of circular cicatrizations.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'bubble' texture created by the extreme density of overlapping circular rosette scars against the dark pigmentation.
